title: ParetoChat: An LLM-Based Interface for Interactive Multi-Objective Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.23062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-objective optimization models are often deployed in settings where decision makers (DMs) must balance some conflicting criteria. In practice, however, stakeholders must translate their qualitative preferences between different criteria into numerical weights, priorities, or reference points required by optimization methods, which can be difficult to specify and interpret. This paper proposes \emph{ParetoChat}, an LLM (large language model)-based expert-agent interface for interactive multi-objective optimization. The agent translates natural-language user input into structured scalarization parameters, invokes an optimization system, presents candidate solutions, and iteratively elicits feedback. We describe a multi-agent architecture that separates input processing, multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) expertise, solution presentation, and feedback processing. translated_title: ParetoChat：一个基于大语言模型的交互式多目标优化界面
translated_abstract: 多目标优化模型通常部署在决策者（DM）需要平衡多个相互冲突准则的场景中。然而在实践中，利益相关者必须将他们在不同准则之间的定性偏好转化为优化方法所需的数值权重、优先级或参考点，而这些参数往往难以指定和解读。本文提出了ParetoChat，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的专家智能体界面，用于交互式多目标优化。该智能体将自然语言的用户输入转化为结构化的标量化参数，调用优化系统，展示候选解，并迭代地获取用户反馈。我们描述了一种多智能体架构，该架构将输入处理、多准则决策（MCDM）专业知识、解的展示和反馈处理分离开来。随后，我们利用基于LLM的决策者智能体和基准问题进行了一项仿真研究……
tldr: 本文提出ParetoChat，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体交互界面，能够将决策者的自然语言偏好自动转化为多目标优化的标量化参数，并通过迭代反馈循环实现交互式多目标优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ParetoChat, an LLM-based multi-agent interface that translates decision makers' natural-language preferences into structured scalarization parameters, enabling interactive multi-objective optimization through iterative feedback loops.
